## Practice
- [Patents](https://www.nolapatent.com/practice/patents/): Patent prosecution and litigation for software, mechanical systems, and energy technologies.
- [Trademarks](https://www.nolapatent.com/practice/trademarks/): Trademark clearance, federal prosecution, and enforcement for brands and businesses.
- [Copyright](https://www.nolapatent.com/practice/copyright/): Copyright counsel for software, websites, books, advertising, and other creative works.
- [Technology & IP](https://www.nolapatent.com/practice/technology/): Software contracts, licensing, open-source issues, and intellectual property counsel from a lawyer who has worked as a software engineer.
